about_pullquote: I started this business to give Guildford honest plumbing at fair prices, no cowboys.
about_para_1: Andy Watson Plumbing & Gas Engineering has served Guildford and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. We're a Gas Safe Registered engineer with a reputation built on turning up on time, fixing problems right the first time, and treating your home with respect. From emergency midnight burst pipes to planned boiler installations, we've handled thousands of jobs and earned the trust of families and businesses across the town.
about_para_2: We don't charge call-out fees and we don't push expensive solutions you don't need. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations because we keep things straightforward and fair. Whether it's a quick tap repair or a full heating system overhaul, you get the same attention to detail and professionalism every time.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Andy came out same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Fair price, no nonsense. Will definitely use again.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Burst pipe at 2am, Andy answered the phone, got here by 2:45. Capped it off, came back next morning to fix it properly. That's the sort of plumber you want.
